response.overview: # English Translation  The story tells of Syafiq who is involved in an accident, regains consciousness and finds himself in a village where he is cared for tenderly by a family with a beautiful daughter. After recovering, Syafiq returns to his village but few people recognize him. Before this incident occurred, Syafiq was a disobedient son to his parents, quite fond of socializing, frequenting nightclubs and associating with motorcycle gangs. One day Syafiq has an accident and falls into a ravine where he is cared for lovingly by a woman. Upon recovery, Syafiq returns to his parents' home and becomes an obedient and well-behaved son. Syafiq wishes to marry the woman and begins searching for her village, but the village apparently does not exist. As he is about to leave the village, Syafiq sees something pass by and tries to avoid it but falls.
